Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Georgian

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Georgian
public class Georgian extends Object
Georgian-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_GEORGIAN section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x15.
